bull.probability_evidence: Dermatology in-clinic share fell 10pp YoY with no sign yet of stabilising against entrants' discounting/bundling (note sec.2, Q2 2026 call); this bull path requires a share stabilisation not yet observed in the data, which the evaluator weights as the least likely of the three outcomes (conviction capped at 4, not 5, per the evaluation's rationale).

target_band.cite: Bull's basis re-rates EV/EBITDA 9.1x->14.3x peer median (89.7% of the gap to the 14.9x 5-year minimum; factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table, RA/P:IDXX/P:ELAN/P:MRK/P:PAHC). Applying the same 89.7% gap-closure fraction to P/E (11.6x->19.76x of its 20.7x min), EV/Sales (3.9x->6.14x of its 6.4x min) and P/FCF (12.7x->23.10x of its 24.3x min) implies $121.49, $112.31 and $129.76 respectively vs the stated $115 target; half the spread ($129.76-$112.31)/2=$8.73 is 7.6% of the target, below the 37.0% blended residual volatility.

base.probability_evidence: Management's own FY2026 guidance (organic revenue -3% to -1%, adjusted net income -9% to -5%, Q2 2026 call per research/ZTS/2026-10-07.md sec.2) is the modal operating outcome already stated by the company, making 'earnings land within the guided range' the single most likely path; the evaluator assigns it the majority (50%) weight versus 20%/30% for bull/bear.

target_band.cite: Base's basis fully closes EV/Sales' 13% discount to the 4.5x peer median (3.9x->4.5x; factsheet Valuation table), which is 25.5% of the gap to EV/Sales' own 6.4x 5-year minimum. Applying the same 25.5% gap-closure fraction to P/E (->13.92x of 20.7x min), EV/EBITDA (->10.58x of 14.9x min) and P/FCF (->15.66x of 24.3x min) implies $85.57, $82.93 and $87.95 vs the stated $83 target; half the spread ($87.95-$82.93)/2=$2.51 is 3.0% of the target.

bear.probability_evidence: Momentum is broken (-50.6% 12-month, 26.9% below the 200-day MA, factsheet Price section) and options flow is bearish into the Nov 5, 2026 print (2,600 puts, 1.4x expected volume, concentrated in Oct/Nov-26 65-strike puts, factsheet News & sentiment); the evaluator weights a further guidance cut (30%) above the bull re-rating (20%) given the trend is still deteriorating.

target_band.cite: Bear's basis holds P/E flat near 11.6x with EPS down ~18.7% to $5.00 (=> $58); the same proportional decline held flat on EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales also implies $58. Applying the FY2022 FCF-conversion low (62.7% vs TTM 87.8%, factsheet Quality table, CF/IS) to the same EPS decline via P/FCF held at its current 12.7x implies ~$39.80 (quality/cash-conversion could compress further in a deeper downturn than EPS alone suggests); half the spread ($58.00-$39.80)/2=$9.10 is 15.7% of the target, below the 37.0% blended residual volatility.

annual_probability.cite: research/ZTS/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks: of the 20 quarterly earnings_release weeks in the 5-year history (2021 Q3 through 2026 Q2), 1 (2026-05-04, Q1 2026) produced a move of this magnitude (>=25%), a per-quarter rate of ~5%; the probability of at least one such print in a year with 4 quarterly releases is 1-(1-0.05)^4 ~= 0.185, rounded to 0.20.

impact.cite: research/ZTS/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls / event_weeks: week of 2026-05-04 (Q1 2026 earnings release, the print that triggered the FY2026 guidance cut described in research/ZTS/2026-10-07.md sec.2) moved -27.44%, the stock's largest weekly fall in the 5-year history.
